section.4: Prayer (Kitab Al-Salat): Detailed Rules of Law about the Prayer during Journey

4.name_native: Prayer (Kitab Al-Salat): Detailed Rules of Law about the Prayer during Journey

hadiths.text: Narrated Anas b. Malik :I prayed along with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) four rak'ahs at the noon prayer at Medina and two rak'ahs at the afternoon prayer in Dhu al-Hulaifah
